verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents automatic categorization of imported transactions (up to 98% auto-categorization, 98% for Brex-connected transactions) and an "ask AI" button for categorization suggestions, so the core suggestion capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the system learning from a user's corrections; custom rules are a manual configuration, not learning. Missing for 10: documented learning from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and accepted, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: 98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction
